subject: Need a Modal workspace with billing for C2 GPUs
body: Abhi's Modal workspace refuses every GPU type (H100, A100-80GB, L40S) without a card on file, and Abhi won't add one. Does anyone's Modal workspace already have billing set up and spare credits for the C2 pilot (Qwen3-30B target, 1 GPU, plus Qwen3-235B auditor, 4 GPUs, capped at about $15)? Otherwise C2 moves its models to Tinker. @nathan-c @david-e
